Presents TR-TEB, a standardized and reproducible benchmark for Turkish text embeddings. It covers five task categories (classification, pair classification, clustering, retrieval and semantic textual similarity), combines 14 open-source resources, 26 translated datasets and 7 new Turkish-specific datasets, and evaluates 45 open-source embedding models.

Research area: [Language Technologies & LLMs](/research/language-tech/).
